author: ValWood
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**


GO:0032264 | IMP salvage | IEA with ARBA00085106


* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

https://www.pombase.org/gene/SPBC1198.02


* **Description of issue**

dea2 does not appear to be involved in IMP salvage, although dea3 is.

See
https://www.pombase.org/gocam/view/gene/680ad14200001682/SPBC1198.02/dea2
title: GO:0032264	 IMP salvage IEA with ARBA00085106

author: PCarme
body: I would say that both dea2 and dea3 are not involved in IMP salvage (they don't produce inosine, at least not directly). If anything, dea3 is "the most" not involved in IMP salvage since it has a NOT annotation [adenosine deaminase activity](https://www.pombase.org/term/GO:0004000) which produces inosine.

author: Antonialock
body: It looks like dea2 and dea3 used to have annotations to IMP salvage from PMID: 18673302 (made by PomBase). They were the experimental masters for this annotation. ARBA should be fixed once we update our curation. The release is scheduled end of this month so I'll check back then to see it's been deleted.
